title: Pure Dark Scorpion
summary: Pure Dark Scorpion combat-damage control strategy centered on Don Zaloog and his crew of classic DARK Warriors, supported by Reinforcement of the Army and generic staples. By pushing through combat with Don Zaloog and Meanae the Thorn, the deck triggers hand destruction, deck milling, and field bouncing before swarming all five members with Mustering of the Dark Scorpions.

summary.title: Starters
points: Reinforcement of the Army searches any Level 4 or lower Dark Scorpion member (Don Zaloog, Meanae, Cliff, or Chick) directly from your Deck.
Don Zaloog is the crew's leader: on inflicting battle damage to the opponent, you can choose to discard 1 random card from their hand or send the top 2 cards of their Deck to the GY.
Dark Scorpion - Meanae the Thorn on dealing battle damage adds any Dark Scorpion card from your Deck or GY to your hand, searching combo Spells or missing members.
Cherubini, Ebon Angel of the Burning Abyss sends any Level 3 monster (such as Cliff or Chick) from Deck to GY as cost and shields linked monsters from effect destruction.

summary.title: Opening: Reinforcement of the Army + Dark Scorpion - Meanae the Thorn
steps: Activate Reinforcement of the Army to search Don Zaloog from your Deck.
Normal Summon Don Zaloog (or Dark Scorpion - Meanae the Thorn).
Equip or back up your monster with defensive handtraps and staple Spells to ensure safe battle engagement.
Declare an attack and deal battle damage; trigger Don Zaloog to rip a card from the opponent's hand.
Set Mustering of the Dark Scorpions and Needle Wall to disrupt the opponent's turn and prepare a full crew swarm.

summary.title: Bosses & Control
points: Don Zaloog continually depletes the opponent's hand and deck resources every time it connects with battle damage.
Dark Scorpion - Cliff the Trap Remover destroys 1 Spell or Trap card on the field (or mills 2 cards from their Deck) when inflicting battle damage.
Dark Scorpion - Chick the Yellow returns 1 card on the field to the owner's hand (or examines the top card of the opponent's Deck) upon dealing battle damage.
Dark Scorpion - Gorg the Strong is a Level 5 member that places 1 monster the opponent controls on top of their Deck when it inflicts battle damage.
Dark Scorpion Burglars forces the opponent to send 1 Spell Card from their Deck to the GY whenever it deals battle damage.

summary.title: Spells & Traps
points: Mustering of the Dark Scorpions can be activated while you control Don Zaloog to Special Summon any number of different Dark Scorpion monsters from your hand (one of each name).

Dark Scorpion Combination can be activated when Don Zaloog, Cliff, Chick, Gorg, and Meanae are all face-up on your field, allowing all five monsters to attack directly this turn with 400 original ATK.
Needle Wall rolls a six-sided die during each of your Standby Phases and destroys a face-up monster in the opponent's corresponding Monster Zone.

summary.title: Left out
summary.text: Trap Dustshoot is Forbidden in the Advanced format and cannot be run despite featuring Cliff in its card art. Isolde and Phantom Knights engines are omitted in favor of the pure gang lineup.
